title: Vickers Wellington BK157
memorial_details: Portrait orientated, dedicatory plaque attached to a shaped boulder of Horton stone set into the ground. At the top of the plaque is a side view line drawing of a Wellington Bomber aircraft with inscription and names below.
inscription: IN MEMORY OF THE CREW OF VICKERS/ WELLINGTON BK157 THAT CRASHED NEAR HERE/ ON THE 31ST MAY 1944 WHILST ON A TRAINING/ FLIGHT FROM RAF CHIPPING WARDEN/ (7 Names)
